items.titolo: OpenAI propone uno standard globale per lo sviluppo AI
items.descrizione: OpenAI ha consigliato l'adozione di uno standard internazionale per lo sviluppo sicuro dei modelli AI con la supervisione degli Stati Uniti. The post OpenAI propone uno standard globale per lo sviluppo AI appeared first

items.titolo: Hands-on with Googlebooks — Five models, the new Googlebook OS, and a Mac-style experience for Android users at premium prices
items.descrizione: Google has detailed its new Googlebooks, five laptops combining Android and ChromeOS to make a Mac-like experience for Android users, with a ton of Gemini tacked on.

items.titolo: OpenAI and Anthropic scramble for smaller data centers as massive gigawatt projects lag — 20-30 MW facilities to provide capacity as mega structures undergo construction
items.descrizione: OpenAI and Anthropic are seeking to secure immediate capacity, through smaller data center deals, to meet current demand, despite spending billions on massive deals elsewhere.
